notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Azorius Chancery.
Azorius Chancery does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Azorius Chancery.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Azorius Chancery to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Repeat.
